ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'New_Corporate_Payments', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Approved_Corporate_Payments' ), ISPICKVAL(Payment_required__c , "Yes"), OR( ISBLANK(Payment_Criteria__c), ISBLANK(TEXT( Payment_Qualified__c )), ISBLANK(Comment__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide value to the following fields if Payment required is "Yes". *Payment Criteria, *Payment Qualified, *Justification/ Reasons
